christian: May God bless my family with health and peace.
Lord, grant me strength for the road ahead.
May His light guide every step I take.
Praying for healing for someone I love.
Thank you, Lord, for another day of grace.
May peace fill this home and every heart in it.
God, watch over my children wherever they are.
For the sick, the lonely, and the weary — Lord, be near.
May faith carry me through this difficult season.
Bless the work of my hands and the intentions of my heart.
Lord, teach me to be patient and kind.
May your mercy find those who have lost their way.
Praying for my parents' health and long life.
For safe travels and a safe return home.
Lord, calm my anxious heart tonight.
May forgiveness heal what anger has broken.
Bless my marriage with patience and joy.
For courage to face what tomorrow brings.
Thank you for the people who love me. Keep them safe.
May I be a blessing to someone today.
Lord, provide for my family's needs.
For wisdom in a hard decision ahead.
May the departed rest in eternal peace.
Praying for peace in every troubled land.
muslim: Ya Allah, grant shifa to the sick. Amin.
Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah wa fil-akhirati hasanah.
Ya Allah, bless my parents as they raised me. Amin.
Allahumma, grant us rizq that is halal and barakah.
Ya Allah, ease every hardship facing the ummah.
Allahumma ajirni minan-nar — protect me from the Fire.
Ya Allah, forgive my sins, the small and the great.
Allahumma, unite my heart with those I love in goodness.
Ya Allah, grant patience to everyone being tested.
Rabbi zidni ilma — my Lord, increase me in knowledge.
Ya Allah, protect my children and guide their steps.
Allahumma, make us among the grateful.
Ya Allah, heal what is broken in our hearts.
Allahumma barik — bless this day and its provisions.
Ya Allah, grant us Jannatul Firdaus. Amin.
Rabbana, accept from us; You are the All-Hearing.
Ya Allah, relief for the oppressed everywhere.
Allahumma, let our last deeds be our best deeds.
Ya Allah, guard my tongue and purify my intentions.
Rabbi ishrah li sadri — my Lord, expand my chest with peace.
Ya Allah, provide for us from where we do not expect.
Allahumma, keep us steadfast on the straight path.
Ya Allah, reunite us with our loved ones in khayr.
Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel — Allah is sufficient for us.
hindu: May all beings be happy and free. Lokah samastah sukhino bhavantu.
Om shanti, shanti, shanti — peace within, peace around, peace everywhere.
May my parents be blessed with health and long life.
May the divine light guide my studies and work.
Wishing strength for every family going through hard times.
May my mind be calm and my actions be righteous.
Praying for the wellbeing of my children.
May good health find everyone I love.
Let my efforts bear fruit and my heart stay humble.
May prosperity visit every home in this world.
For the courage to do what is right, not what is easy.
May every diya I light remove someone's darkness.
Wishing peace for the souls of our ancestors.
May wisdom grow in me like the banyan tree.
For success in my exams and endeavors. Om.
May compassion rule my words and deeds.
Bless my marriage and my family with harmony.
May the sick recover and the weary find rest.
Gratitude for today's breath, food, and shelter.
May I see the divine in everyone I meet.
For rain where there is drought, and hope where there is despair.
May my work serve something greater than myself.
Shubh kamna — good wishes for every traveler on this path.
May truth win, in my life and in the world.
jewish: May you be blessed and guarded in all your ways.
Refuah shlema — complete healing for the sick.
May this home be filled with shalom and simcha.
In memory of those we love — may their memory be a blessing.
May you go from strength to strength.
For peace in Jerusalem and in every city.
May your table always have bread and your heart always have song.
Bless my children with health, wisdom, and kindness.
May the coming year be sweet like apples and honey.
For courage to repair what is broken — tikkun olam.
May we be inscribed in the book of good life.
Ken yehi ratzon — may it be His will for good.
May your work prosper and your rest be sweet.
For the lonely — may they find their people.
May justice roll like water and righteousness like a stream.
Bless the hands that give and the hearts that forgive.
May we merit to see peace in our days.
For safe journeys and joyful returns.
May your candle burn bright through every storm.
Gam zu l'tovah — may this too be revealed as good.
May we learn from every person and every moment.
For health of body and peace of mind.
May kindness meet you at every door.
Baruch Hashem for today, and hope for tomorrow.
buddhist: May all beings be free from suffering.
May I meet this day with a calm and open heart.
For my mother's health and peace of mind.
May anger dissolve like salt in water.
Wishing clarity for every confused heart tonight.
May my words today plant no thorns.
For the strength to let go of what I cannot control.
May every candle lit here warm a distant heart.
For patience with myself as I grow.
May all who grieve find gentle passage.
For gratitude — this breath, this moment, is enough.
May I be less reactive and more present.
For the wellbeing of all creatures, seen and unseen.
May wisdom arise naturally from stillness.
For those in pain: may your burden lighten today.
May I forgive myself, and begin again.
For kind speech, honest work, and a quiet mind.
May merit flow to everyone I have ever loved.
For freedom from craving, one breath at a time.
May the sick be healed and the fearful be comforted.
For equanimity in praise and in blame.
May every step I take be on the path of compassion.
For the courage to sit with discomfort without running.
Sadhu, sadhu — may goodness ripen everywhere.
chinese: 愿家人平安健康，岁岁无忧。
愿所求皆如愿，所行化坦途。
愿父母身体硬朗，笑口常开。
愿孩子学业进步，前程似锦。
愿山河无恙，人间皆安。
愿病痛消散，早日康复。
愿工作顺利，贵人相助。
愿财源广进，取之有道。
愿考试上岸，金榜题名。
愿旅途平安，满载而归。
愿婚姻美满，白头偕老。
愿烦恼退散，夜夜安眠。
愿故去的亲人安息，生者坚强。
愿所有等待都不被辜负。
愿善良的人都得好报。
愿腹中宝宝健康出生，母子平安。
愿老兵不死，薪火相传。
愿疫情灾祸远离这片土地。
愿我不忘初心，方得始终。
愿漂泊的人早日归家。
愿每个认真生活的人都被温柔以待。
愿心事有处说，眼泪有人懂。
愿来年风调雨顺，五谷丰登。
愿天下无拐，万家团圆。
愿世界和平，众生安乐。
愿我爱的人和爱我的人，都被岁月善待。
愿生意兴隆，客似云来。
愿病痛中的人今夜不再疼。
愿迷途的人找到回家的路。
愿这一刻的灯火，照亮在乎的人。
